definition.description: Retrieves all members of a group from Microsoft Graph API with automatic pagination. Returns directory objects (users, groups, service principals, etc.) that are members of the specified group. Supports filtering by member type and field selection to optimize payload size.

inputFields.helpText: Microsoft Graph OAuth access token with GroupMember.Read.All or Directory.Read.All permissions. Obtain via OAuth 2.0 flow or use the Connector Token node.
The Azure AD object ID (GUID) of the group whose members to retrieve. Supports placeholders for dynamic lookups.
Maximum number of pages to fetch. Acts as a safety limit to prevent runaway requests for large groups. Set higher for complete member enumeration.
Number of members to retrieve per API request. Microsoft Graph supports up to 999 per page. Larger values reduce API calls but increase response time.
Comma-separated list of member properties to return (e.g., id,displayName,mail). Reduces response payload. Leave empty to return all default properties.

outputParameters.description: Array containing all group member objects. Each object includes @odata.type to identify if it's a user, group, or service principal.
Serialized JSON string of all members array, ready for storage or transmission to external systems
Total count of member objects retrieved across all pages
Number of members that are user objects (@odata.type contains 'user')
Number of members that are nested group objects (@odata.type contains 'group')
Number of members that are other types (service principals, devices, etc.)
Number of API requests made during pagination. Useful for monitoring API consumption.
Boolean flag indicating if any errors occurred during the fetch operation
Detailed error message including HTTP status code, page number where failure occurred, and exception details

connectionTags.description: Triggered when all pages were fetched successfully and the group has at least one member
Triggered when the group exists but has no members
Triggered when an API error, group not found (404), or exception occurs during the request
